events.title: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling at Next Fest
events.summary: It has been intense week of work to create best possible demo for the Next Fest! Thanks for everyone trying out the demo and giving out the feedback! It has been really nice to see people play the game online or locally! I hope you enjoy the updated demo! Please leave a wishlist to help support the game! Small summary of the changes:Updated textures for most of the charactersUpdated UIsUpdated FontUpdated Game EndingNew MusicNew SFXBalance changes Thank you!

events.title: Demo Updated for the Finnish Games Week!
events.summary: Hello everyone! Supinaa: Rogue Sapling is part of the Finnish Game Week event! Try out the demo and wishlist the game if you enjoy it! events.title: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling Release Date Announcement!
events.summary: Hello everyone! I have been working hard on the game and preparing for the Steam Next Fest. I created the trailer for the game and you should check it out! Game is set to release on November 16th. I have increased the size of my company and currently I have two employees working on the game and creating art and music.
